titles.title: a lost freshman on their first day

questions.q: What year was California Baptist University founded?
questions.fact: It started in 1950 as California Baptist College, in El Monte.

questions.q: What city is CBU's campus in?
What are CBU's school colors?
What was CBU called before it became a university?
In what year did California Baptist College become California Baptist University?
Which NCAA division does CBU compete in?
questions.fact: The Lancers moved up to Division I in 2018.

questions.q: Which athletic conference do the Lancers play in?
questions.fact: The Lancers joined the Big West on July 1, 2026, after years in the WAC.

questions.q: What street is CBU's main campus on?
What is CBU's motto?
CBU's college of engineering is named after which family?
questions.fact: It is the Gordon and Jill Bourns College of Engineering.

questions.q: Before it moved to Riverside, what city was California Baptist College in?
questions.fact: The college moved from El Monte to Riverside in 1955.

questions.q: Who has been CBU's president since 1994?
What is the name of CBU's costumed mascot?
Which student organization built me?
What kind of robot am I?
questions.fact: A Reachy Mini, from Pollen Robotics.

questions.q: What is the name of CBU Motorsports' newest electric race car?
questions.fact: It races at Michigan in June 2027.

questions.q: Every June, where does CBU Motorsports race in the Formula SAE Electric competition?
questions.fact: It's a four-day international competition, with teams from all over the world.

questions.q: What was the name of CBU's very first electric race car?
questions.fact: eLancer 1 raced at Michigan in 2022. The electric team was founded in 2021 by Mathias Scarano.

questions.q: How many battery cells are packed into Charger 6?
questions.fact: 432 cells in six modules, for 7.8 kilowatt-hours.

questions.q: The team designs its own battery management system for Charger 6. What is it called?
questions.fact: It weighs under a pound. An off-the-shelf one is about five.

questions.q: What does DRS stand for on Charger 6's rear wing?
questions.fact: A servo flattens part of the rear wing on the straights and cuts its drag by about a third.

questions.q: In what year did CBU's combustion and electric teams merge to become CBU Motorsports?
questions.fact: The combustion team dates back to 2016, and the electric team to 2021.

questions.q: How many subsystems is Charger 6 split into, each with its own student lead?
questions.fact: Aero, composites, suspension, vehicle dynamics, chassis, battery, powertrain and cooling, driver controls, electronics and data.

questions.q: In miles per hour, what is Charger 6's simulated top speed?
What brand of motor powers Charger 6?
questions.fact: An EMRAX 228 axial-flux motor, 124 kilowatts at peak.

questions.q: Who is the president of CBU Motorsports this year?
questions.fact: He leads Charger 6, with a goal of driving every event at Michigan.

questions.q: Out of 1,000 points, what is the team's goal for Charger 6 at Michigan?
